title: Verify a complete ordinary descriptor converter call
changes: Add an entry-to-return comparison for the original descriptor converter on the retained ordinary battle-entry route, with the shared descriptor row altered in the managed machine.
validation: Windows GNU build we2i_qjd and Wine _hfk7lti passed: one 25,222-instruction interpreter call returned with matching full state, clock, video, OAM and mixed audio; the original reader issued one typed row request, with no raw or unclassified row reads. Protected inputs passed, scratch was removed and Wine drained.
Initial Wine l4i2lrcu failed to locate a matching call to batch wrapper 080ce18c; that failed unit remains retained.
limitations: One interpreter call on one route within one input frame; the batch wrapper, other calls, consumers, per-read native attribution and other platforms remain open. The audio equality check does not require nonempty audio.
